note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Extra keys (note, followup, manual_prepare, manual_teardown) are for the recorder person; the kit ignores them. DATAVERSE_URL must point at the Sales trial environment (trial ends about 21 Dec 2026). Every python command opens its own MSAL interactive sign-in (the token cache is in memory): the owner signs in as labadmin when the browser asks, or exports the app-registration variables in the shell before recording (never in a file). The chart screen needs the chart not to exist yet (teardown/manual_teardown deletes it).
prepare: if (-not $env:DATAVERSE_URL) { throw 'Set $env:DATAVERSE_URL to the lab environment URL in this shell first (the owner does this; it is never written in a file).' }
manual_prepare: Sales Hub as labadmin: check the Opportunities list has sample data; optionally add fictional opportunities with estimated close dates.

Power BI Desktop: Get data, Dataverse, server <org>.crm4.dynamics.com (no https://, no trailing slash), table opportunity (Import); card with sum of estimated value and column chart by forecast category, filter Status = Open; total must equal reportkit pipeline.
TDS endpoint on and TCP 1433 (or 5558) reachable from the laptop.

screens.name: reportkit-reconcile
screens.note: If a line says MISMATCH keep it and explain it. If msdyn_forecastcategory is missing use --by statuscode everywhere and say so.

screens.name: saleshub-chart
steps: Select the Sales trial environment, Apps, open Sales Hub (play)
Show the chart pane and pick '[MGL demo] Open pipeline by forecast category' in the chart selector
Show columns per forecast category with value labels
mask: tenant name in the top bar
environment name and org URL (address bar and header)
user e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: powerbi-pipeline
steps: Open the prepared (unsaved) report: Home, Get data, Dataverse (show the dialog, URL masked)
Card: sum of estimated value filtered to Status = Open; next to it the column chart by forecast category
Confirm the card total equals the total printed by reportkit pipeline
mask: environment URL in Data source settings and the Transform data pane
account name in the top right

manual_teardown: Delete the [MGL demo] charts (Sales Hub chart pane, manage) and any opportunities added for the demo.
Close Power BI Desktop without saving the .pbix (it holds the environment URL); delete exports.
needs: trial:Dynamics 365 Sales trial environment (ends about 21 Dec 2026)
network:TCP 1433 or 5558 to the Dataverse TDS endpoint
